verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּב֤וֹא גַֽם־ הַשָּׂטָן֙ בְּתֹכָ֔ם לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hay·yō·wm way·yā·ḇō·’ū bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh way·yā·ḇō·w ḡam- haś·śā·ṭān bə·ṯō·ḵām lə·hiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- Yah·weh
verses.literal: On another day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD and Satan also came with them to present himself before Him
verses.literalPt: E, VINDO outro dia, em que os filhos de Deus vieram apresentar-se perante o SENHOR, veio também Satanás entre eles, apresentar-se perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשֻּׁ֣ט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān ’ê miz·zeh tā·ḇō way·ya·‘an haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar miš·šuṭ bā·’ā·reṣ ū·mê·hiṯ·hal·lêḵ bāh
verses.literal: Where . . . have you come from said the LORD to Satan From roaming through the earth he replied and walking back and forth in it
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR disse a Satanás: Donde vens? E respondeu Satanás ao SENHOR, e disse: De rodear a terra, e passear por ela.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הֲשַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֮ אֶל־ עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין כָּמֹ֜הוּ בָּאָ֗רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וְעֹדֶ֙נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּת֔וֹ וַתְּסִיתֵ֥נִי ב֖וֹ לְבַלְּע֥וֹ חִנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hă·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā ’el- ‘aḇ·dî ’î·yō·wḇ kî ’ên kā·mō·hū bā·’ā·reṣ ’îš tām wə·yā·šār yə·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·sār mê·rā‘ wə·‘ō·ḏen·nū ma·ḥă·zîq bə·ṯum·mā·ṯōw wat·tə·sî·ṯê·nî ḇōw lə·ḇal·lə·‘ōw ḥin·nām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Satan Have you considered . . . . . . My servant Job For there is no one on earth like him a man who is blameless and upright who fears God and shuns evil He still retains his integrity even though you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Satanás: Observaste o meu servo Jó? Porque ninguém há na terra semelhante a ele, homem íntegro e reto, temente a Deus e que se desvia do mal, e que ainda retém a sua sinceridade, havendo-me tu incitado contra ele, para o consumir sem causa.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן הַשָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ע֣וֹר בְּעַד־ ע֗וֹר וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָאִ֔ישׁ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּעַ֥ד נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an haś·śā·ṭān ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ‘ō·wr bə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·wr wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lā·’îš yit·tên bə·‘aḏ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Skin for skin Satan replied . . . A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life
verses.literalPt: Então Satanás respondeu ao SENHOR, e disse: Pele por pele, e tudo quanto o homem tem dará pela sua vida.

verses.original: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־ נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֥ע אֶל־ עַצְמ֖וֹ וְאֶל־ בְּשָׂר֑וֹ אִם־ לֹ֥א אֶל־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lām šə·laḥ- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·ḡa‘ ’el- ‘aṣ·mōw wə·’el- bə·śā·rōw ’im- lō ’el- pā·ne·ḵā yə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·kā
verses.literal: But stretch out . . . Your hand and strike his flesh and bones . . . and he will surely . . . curse You to Your face
verses.literalPt: Porém estende a tua mão, e toca-lhe nos ossos, e na carne, e verás se não blasfema contra ti na tua face!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הַשָּׂטָ֖ן הִנּ֣וֹ בְיָדֶ֑ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֥וֹ שְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- haś·śā·ṭān hin·nōw ḇə·yā·ḏe·ḵā ’aḵ ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw šə·mōr
verses.literal: Very well said the LORD . . . to Satan He is in your hands but you must spare his life
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Satanás: Eis que ele está na tua mão; porém guarda a sua vida.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵאֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ אִיּוֹב֙ בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֔ע מִכַּ֥ף רַגְל֖וֹ עַד קָדְקֳדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê haś·śā·ṭān mê·’êṯ pə·nê Yah·weh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ biš·ḥîn rā‘ mik·kap̄ raḡ·lōw ʿaḏ qā·ḏə·qo·ḏōw
verses.literal: So Satan . . . went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head
verses.literalPt: Então saiu Satanás da presença do SENHOR, e feriu a Jó de úlceras malignas, desde a planta do pé até ao alto da cabeça.

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֣וֹ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לְהִתְגָּרֵ֖ד בּ֑וֹ וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּתוֹךְ־ הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw ḥe·reś lə·hiṯ·gā·rêḏ bōw wə·hū yō·šêḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ- hā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes
verses.literalPt: E Jó tomou um caco para se raspar com ele; e estava assentado no meio da cinza.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ עֹדְךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּתֶ֑ךָ בָּרֵ֥ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֻֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’iš·tōw ‘ō·ḏə·ḵā ma·ḥă·zîq bə·ṯum·mā·ṯe·ḵā bā·rêḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·muṯ
verses.literal: Then Job’s wife said to him Do you still retain your integrity Curse God and die
verses.literalPt: Então sua mulher lhe disse: Ainda reténs a tua sinceridade? Amaldiçoa a Deus, e morre.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ כְּדַבֵּ֞ר אַחַ֤ת הַנְּבָלוֹת֙ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַטּ֗וֹב נְקַבֵּל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאֶת־ הָרָ֖ע לֹ֣א נְקַבֵּ֑ל בְּכָל־ זֹ֛את לֹא־ חָטָ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā kə·ḏab·bêr ’a·ḥaṯ han·nə·ḇā·lō·wṯ tə·ḏab·bê·rî gam ’eṯ- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ nə·qab·bêl mê·’êṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’eṯ- hā·rā‘ lō nə·qab·bêl bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- ḥā·ṭā ’î·yō·wḇ biś·p̄ā·ṯāw
verses.literal: You speak as a foolish woman speaks . . . he told her Should we accept from God only good and not . . . adversity In all this Job did not sin in what he said
verses.literalPt: Porém ele lhe disse: Como fala qualquer doida, falas tu; receberemos o bem de Deus, e não receberíamos o mal? Em tudo isto não pecou Jó com os seus lábios.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת׀ רֵעֵ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֮ הַבָּ֣אָה עָלָיו֒ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ אֱלִיפַ֤ז הַתֵּימָנִי֙ וּבִלְדַּ֣ד הַשּׁוּחִ֔י וְצוֹפַ֖ר הַנַּֽעֲמָתִ֑י וַיִּוָּעֲד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָב֥וֹא לָנֽוּד־ ל֖וֹ וּֽלְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū šə·lō·šeṯ rê·‘ê ’î·yō·wḇ ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ hab·bā·’āh ‘ā·lāw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’îš mim·mə·qō·mōw ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî ū·ḇil·daḏ haš·šū·ḥî wə·ṣō·w·p̄ar han·na·‘ă·mā·ṯî way·yiw·wā·‘ă·ḏū yaḥ·dāw lā·ḇō·w lā·nūḏ- lōw ū·lə·na·ḥă·mōw
verses.literal: Now when Job’s three friends Eliphaz the Temanite Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite heard about all this adversity that had come upon him each of them came from his home and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, três amigos de Jó todo este mal que tinha vindo sobre ele, vieram cada um do seu lugar: Elifaz o temanita, e Bildade o suíta, e Zofar o naamatita; e combinaram condoer-se dele, para o consolarem.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֨וּ אֶת־ עֵינֵיהֶ֤ם מֵרָחוֹק֙ וְלֹ֣א הִכִּירֻ֔הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּ֑וּ וַֽיִּקְרְעוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְעִל֔וֹ וַיִּזְרְק֥וּ עָפָ֛ר עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ê·nê·hem mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·lō hik·kî·ru·hū way·yiś·’ū qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū way·yiq·rə·‘ū ’îš mə·‘i·lōw way·yiz·rə·qū ‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- rā·šê·hem haš·šā·mā·yə·māh
verses.literal: When they lifted up their eyes from afar they could barely recognize Job They began to weep aloud . . . and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head
verses.literalPt: E, levantando de longe os seus olhos, não o conheceram; e levantaram a sua voz e choraram, e rasgaram cada um o seu manto, e sobre as suas cabeças lançaram pó ao ar.

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֤וּ אִתּוֹ֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת לֵיל֑וֹת וְאֵין־ דֹּבֵ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי־ גָדַ֥ל הַכְּאֵ֖ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū ’it·tōw lā·’ā·reṣ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ lê·lō·wṯ wə·’ên- dō·ḇêr ’ê·lāw dā·ḇār kî rā·’ū kî- ḡā·ḏal hak·kə·’êḇ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights but no one spoke a word to him because they saw how intense his suffering was
verses.literalPt: E assentaram-se com ele na terra, sete dias e sete noites; e nenhum lhe dizia palavra alguma, porque viam que a dor era muito grande.
